name: Big Red Barn Farmers' Market
tagline: New farmers market creates new draw at Maplewood historic farmstead
description: Big Red Barn Farmers' Market is a farmers market in 2170 Co Rd E East, MN, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
